event_chain.summary: Publishing error on public GIS map

summary: The City of Belleville, Ontario disclosed on July 7, 2026 that an administrative error had made limited property assessment information and associated contact details (telephone numbers and email addresses) publicly accessible through a GIS mapping service. Access was removed once discovered; no passwords, financial data or SINs were involved and it was not a cyberattack. The city notified Ontario's Information and Privacy Commissioner.
